recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-12158 unless a future workflow-pattern issue intentionally revisits Request identifier, groupIdentifier, or supportingInfo semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12158 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the DSTU2 Request logical pattern. It requested Request.identifier to be 0..*, supportingInfo to be 0..*, and Request.requisition to be renamed to a grouper concept, resolved as Request.groupIdentifier with requisition retained as an alias.
initial_application: Imported SVN commits 6cab91a3e0 and 83f1205cc1 applied the request: 6cab91a3e0 renamed Request.requisition to Request.groupIdentifier, added the requisition alias, and changed the search parameter to group-identifier; 83f1205cc1 changed Request.identifier and Request.supportingInfo from 0..1 to 0..* and matches the Jira svn @10162 comment.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request as an active logical pattern, so source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml is current build scope. Later same-element maintenance, including FHIR-37966's groupIdentifier wording clarification, did not reverse the FHIR-12158 name, alias, or cardinality decisions. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source has Request.identifier 0..*, Request.groupIdentifier with alias 'grouperId, requisition', and Request.supportingInfo 0..*, and no active Request.requisition element remains in the Request pattern source.
